;Health and environment
*[[Air quality in Delhi]]
**A blanket of thick grey smog covers the [[India]]n capital, [[Delhi]], with some areas 30 times more polluted than the [[World Health Organization]]'s recommended limit, one year after [[Great smog of Delhi|a similar smog]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-41896676 (BBC)]
*[[North Korea and weapons of mass destruction]]
**A [[North Korea]]n [[North Korean defectors|defector]] claims children are being born with deformities near North Korea's [[Punggye-ri Nuclear Test Site|nuclear testing site]]. [http://www.foxnews.com/world/2017/11/07/north-koreas-nuclear-test-site-causing-deformed-babies-killing-vegetation-defectors-say.html (Fox News)]

;International relations
*[[Yemeni Crisis (2011–present)]]
**[[Saudi Arabia]]'s Crown Prince [[Mohammad bin Salman]] accuses [[Iran]] of an act of "direct military aggression" by supplying missiles to rebels in [[Yemen]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-41899643 (BBC)]
*[[South Korea–United States relations]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] visits [[South Korea]] amidst a [[2017 North Korea crisis|crisis]] with [[North Korea]]. [http://www.cnn.com/2017/11/06/politics/trump-asia-south-korea-latest/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Paris Agreement#Parties and signatories|Paris Agreement parties and signatories]]
**[[Syria]] signs the [[Paris Agreement]]. This will make the [[United States]] the only country not in the Paris Agreement, when they [[United States withdrawal from the Paris Agreement|plan to leave]] on 4 November 2020. [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2017/nov/07/syria-signs-paris-climate-agreement-and-leaves-us-isolated (''The Guardian'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Crime in Japan]]
**Former millionaire [[Chisako Kakehi]] (also known as [[Japan]]'s "Black Widow") is [[Capital punishment in Japan|sentenced to death]] for the murder of 3 men which included a husband. [http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/japans-black-widow-to-be-hanged-for-mens-deaths/ar-AAuxbUk?li=BBnb7Kz&ocid=iehp (AFP via MSN)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-41898623 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[United States elections, 2017]]
**Voters in [[New Jersey gubernatorial election, 2017|New Jersey]] and [[Virginia gubernatorial election, 2017|Virginia]] chose new governors. [http://www.cnn.com/2017/11/04/politics/2017-election-readers-guide-virginia-new-jersey-governor/index.html (CNN)]
***[[Phil Murphy (politician)|Philip Murphy]] wins the New Jersey gubernatorial election. [https://www.nytimes.com/elections/results/new-jersey-general-elections (''The New York Times'')]
***[[Ralph Northam]] wins the Virginia gubernatorial election. [https://www.nytimes.com/elections/results/virginia-governor-election-gillespie-northam (''The New York Times'')]
***In the [[Virginia House of Delegates]] election, Democrats win 15 seats, Republicans lose 18 seats, and 3 seats are too close to call. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/virginia-politics/potential-chaos-ahead-as-control-of-virginia-house-of-delegates-hangs-in-balance/2017/11/08/bef75346-c448-11e7-84bc-5e285c7f4512_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
**Voters in [[New York state Constitutional Convention of 2018|New York]] reject a ballot initiative that, if passed, would have resulted in a Constitutional Convention being convened to change in the [[New York Constitution|current state constitution]]. [https://patch.com/new-york/new-york-city/2017-new-york-constitutional-convention-vote-what-you-need-know (Patch.com)] [http://www.businessinsider.com/new-york-constitutional-convention-vote-pros-cons-2017-11 (''Business Insider'')] [https://www.nytimes.com/elections/results/new-york-general-elections (''The New York Times'')]
**Voters in [[Utah's 3rd congressional district special election, 2017|Utah's 3rd congressional district]] choose [[John Curtis (Utah politician)|John Curtis]] to win the representative seat in the special election. [http://www.cnn.com/2017/11/04/politics/2017-election-readers-guide-virginia-new-jersey-governor/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.nytimes.com/elections/results/utah-house-special-election (''The New York Times'')]
**Former US District attorney [[Jenny Durkan]] is [[Seattle mayoral election, 2017|elected]] mayor of [[Seattle]], becoming the city's first woman mayor since 1926. [https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/politics/seattle-mayoral-race-jenny-durkan-cary-moon/ (''The Seattle Times'')]
**[[Maine]] votes to expand [[Medicaid]] under [[Obamacare]] in the first ever referendum on the issue. [http://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/maine-oks-medicaid-expansion-kind-referendum-51006981 (ABC News)]
